'''Sahra Covenry''' was a [[novice]] in the [[White Tower]].{{ref/book|twotc|Sahra Covenry}} According to Elaida, she was a daydreamer with moderate ability who would never be of any real power.{{ref/book|4|1}}

== Appearance ==
She had black hair and was around fifteen or sixteen.

== Activities ==
She escorted [[Min Farshaw]] to the [[Amyrlin Seat]].{{ref/book|4|1}} Because Gawyn identified Min in front of Sahra, she was sent to the country as "penance" to keep her from gossiping about Min. While working on the farm, an [[Aes Sedai]] approached her and asked about Min. Sahra was killed after the interrogation.{{ref/book|4|17}} 

The killer must have been of the [[Black Ajah]] since Sahra was interrogated and killed with ''[[saidar]]''. The motive behind the murder was surely to find information on Min's connection to the Amyrlin [[Siuan Sanche]]; part of the plot to have her deposed. The most likely candidate is [[Alviarin Freidhen]] or someone at her command, since she was working closely with Elaida on said plot.

Siuan received a report that Sahra disappeared along with the farmer that managed the farm.{{ref/book|4|47}}
